1) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein the molar ratio of polyanion to polyalkylenimine is greater than 1:1.

2) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is present in an amount sufficient to crosslink a separate polymer composition.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, wherein the amount of said multivalent cation crosslinker is controlled to provide delayed gelling functionality.

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, wherein the nanoparticle exhibits a predominance of negative surface charge.

9) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater, and wherein said nanoparticles are formulated to release the polyalkylenimine and polyanion upon exposure to a reservoir environment.

10) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein the molar ratio of PVS to polyalkylenimine is greater than 1:1.

12) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, wherein said multivalent cation is present in an amount and form designed to provide delayed crosslinking of a separate polymer.

13) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, wherein the multivalent cation is complexed or chelated within the nanoparticle.

21) (Currently amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a), wherein said polymer comprises anionic functional groups; and c) a fluid.

22) (Cancelled)

23) (Cancelled)

24) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, wherein said polymer has a molecular weight greater than 100,000 Da.

26) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 21, where said fluid is brine or seawater, and wherein the composition exhibits delayed gelling behavior upon exposure to reservoir temperature and pressure conditions.
